links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM evidence synthesis and overstated evidence in predicted guideline updates
links.effect: Models captured 36.7% to 40% of substantive updates, frequently overstating evidence; extraction accuracy up to 99.2% for single studies but declined in multisource synthesis.
links.quote: In the predictive task, models captured 36.7% to 40% of substantive updates, often identifying landmark approvals, but frequently overstating evidence.

links.outcome: Position-dependent accuracy decline in long-form LLM-generated guideline drafts
links.effect: GPT's endpoint accuracy dropped from 84.6% in the first half of the drafted guideline to 38.5% in the second half.
links.quote: We observed a position-dependent performance drop in long-form generation, with GPT's endpoint accuracy dropping from 84.6% in the first half of the drafted guideline to 38.5% in the second half.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs as automated auditors to detect formal and content errors in existing clinical guidelines
Stacked LLM workflow with human-led review for guideline maintenance

screen.reason: Empirical case study evaluating frontier LLMs on clinical practice guideline maintenance tasks (predicting updates, trial data extraction, and guideline auditing) compared against official revisions.
